## VSiN on this hire — The Coaching Carousel Never Stops

*Adam Burke, p. 36. GUIDE CONTENT — TTW reference notes summarising the guide's assessment; the judgement is the guide's.*

The guide places the hire in context of the market for coaches: after a decade at Memphis, Silverfield took what it calls probably the only SEC opportunity he was ever going to get. It says it would be unfair to call him the last person at the bar when the lights came on, while stating AD Hunter Yurachek had two strikes in the count and had to put a ball in play. It rates him the bronze medalist behind Sumrall and Golesh and explains why: he inherited a good programme and a FedEx-backed NIL budget at Memphis and never won the conference. It closes on the pattern that Arkansas replaced one offensive-line coach with another, chasing only its second ranked finish since 2011.
